messages.subject: Re: Live music — Jake Essex
messages.body:
Hi Natalie,

Thanks for getting in touch and for your interest in playing at Rushden Cons Club.

To make sure every act is treated fairly, we ask all bands to complete our entertainment registry:
https://rushdenconsclub.co.uk/entertainment-registry/

Once you’ve done that, we will review your response and get back to you.

Kind regards,
Steve
